start.title: [TODO:tr] The First Breath
start.text:
[TODO:tr] You open your eyes in a warm garden.
A voice within whispers: you are loved.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Peace settles deep in your chest.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Run off to test your strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] The garden answers only with silence.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Demand to know who made you
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] The voice does not answer demands.

naming.title: [TODO:tr] Naming the Creatures
naming.text:
[TODO:tr] Animals gather, waiting.
The Lord asks you to name each one.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Each name fits as if it were always theirs.
[TODO:tr] They wait, patient and confused.

lonely.title: [TODO:tr] Alone Among Pairs
lonely.text:
[TODO:tr] Every creature has its match.
Only you stand alone.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You breathe, and let the ache become prayer.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Search the wild on your own
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You walk far. Nothing fills the silence.
[TODO:tr] Bitterness only deepens the loneliness.

deep_sleep.title: [TODO:tr] A Deep Sleep
deep_sleep.text:
[TODO:tr] A great peace covers you.
Your eyes close, and the Lord works.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You let go. Something new begins.
[TODO:tr] You cannot resist His hand. Sleep comes anyway.

meet_eve.title: [TODO:tr] Bone of My Bone
meet_eve.text:
[TODO:tr] You wake — and she is there.
A woman, made for you, equal to you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] "This at last is bone of my bone."
[TODO:tr] She lowers her eyes. The garden grows quieter.
[TODO:tr] She follows, unsure why you turn away.

warning.title: [TODO:tr] The Forbidden Tree
warning.text:
[TODO:tr] God shows you one tree set apart.
"Do not eat from this one, or you will die."

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Peace returns. The garden feels safe.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Wonder why He hides it from you
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] A seed of suspicion takes root.
[TODO:tr] The thought lingers, sweet and dangerous.

serpent.title: [TODO:tr] The Serpent's Question
serpent.text:
[TODO:tr] A serpent speaks to Eve:
"Did God really say you must not eat?"

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stand beside her — repeat God's word
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You speak the truth aloud. The serpent hisses.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stay silent and let her answer
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Her voice trembles. You say nothing.
[TODO:tr] The whisper begins to feel reasonable.

fruit.title: [TODO:tr] The Fruit in Her Hand
fruit.text:
[TODO:tr] Eve has taken the fruit. She offers it to you.
Her eyes plead — and burn.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Your hand drops to your side. But she has already eaten.
[TODO:tr] Sweet. Then bitter. Then — you know.
[TODO:tr] Love twists into disobedience. You bite.

shame.title: [TODO:tr] Eyes Opened
shame.text:
[TODO:tr] You see yourselves — bare, afraid.
Fig leaves cannot cover what has changed.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Shame becomes sorrow. Sorrow opens a door.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Run and hide in the trees
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You crouch in the brush. His voice still finds you.
[TODO:tr] The anger feels safe. It is not.

confrontation.title: [TODO:tr] "Where Are You?"
confrontation.text:
[TODO:tr] The Lord walks in the garden and calls.
His voice is not angry — it is grieved.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Truth is heavy. And it sets something free.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] "The woman You gave me did it"
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You point. The blame does not save you.
[TODO:tr] Silence cannot hide a fallen heart.

expulsion.title: [TODO:tr] East of Eden
expulsion.text:
[TODO:tr] He clothes you both, then opens the gate.
You take her hand. You walk east, into the world.
